reported.title: No debounce: every bounce edge toggles the lamp
reported.description: The loop reads the raw pin and calls flipLamp() on every HIGH-to-LOW transition (lines 50-55 via isPressedEdge at lines 26-29), with no 40 ms settle window or state machine, so contact bounce is counted as multiple presses. Measured evidence: bounce scenario toggled D11 4 times per press ([4,4,4,4]), rapid presses 3 times each, and a 35 ms chatter train produced 11 toggles for one physical press. The spec requires exactly one toggle per settled press and no extra toggles from bounce up to 20 ms. 4 of 4 press(es) did not toggle D11 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [4, 4, 4, 4]. D11 also toggled 12 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 1.40 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Momentary wall switch on D5 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); foyer lamp driver on D11.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; releasing the switch must not toggle.
- Contact bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Debounce / settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge.
- Every 1500 ms print `foyer lamp=ON` or `foyer lamp=OFF`.
- Idle (unpressed) switch reads HIGH; a physical press is a HIGH-to-LOW transition after settle.
